channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: What do you call a robot that always takes the longest route?
item.description:
What do you call a robot that always takes the longest route?
R2 detour!

item.title: Why did the alien throw beef on the asteroid?
item.description:
Why did the alien throw beef on the asteroid?
He wanted it a little meteor!

item.title: What do you do when you see a spaceman?
item.description:
What do you do when you see a spaceman?
Park in it!

item.title: How much is the moon worth?
item.description:
How much is the moon worth?
One dollar, because it has four quarters.

item.title: What do you give an alien?
item.description:

Some space!

item.title: How do the aliens get their babies to sleep?
item.description:
How do the aliens get their babies to sleep?
They ROCKET!

item.title: What holds the moon up?

Moon beams!

item.title: What do planets like to read?

Comet books!

item.title: What did the father tomato say to the baby tomato while out for a walk?
item.description:
What did the father tomato say to the baby tomato while out for a walk?
Ketchup!
